## [1.5.0](https://github.com/d0nj/morphe-patches/compare/v1.4.2...v1.5.0) (2026-11-01)

### ✨ New Features

* add Firefox Nightly branding patch ([cdcb33a](https://github.com/d0nj/morphe-patches/commit/cdcb33a40029115cf201f99ebad4b7d9ce91e3b8))

patches.name: Fix home screen numbers tile
patches.description: Stops a Channels diagnostic tip from rendering as a tile of giant numbers on the home feed.

patches.name: Remove analytics
patches.description: Disables Niagara's usage-report uploads, retention events and analytics SDK sessions.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Makes the entitlement holder always report Pro in Niagara Launcher. Unlocks all Pro features and bypasses the 7-day trial prompt. Server-backed features (account sync, Stripe checkout) are not affected.

patches.name: Use Open-Meteo for weather
patches.description: Fetches weather from the free Open-Meteo API instead of Niagara's, so the at-a-glance tile works without an account.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Makes isPremium() always return true in AI Audio Novel Reader. Unlocks all premium features and disables the 10-hour trial countdown.

patches.name: Firefox Nightly branding
patches.description: Replaces the Firefox launcher icon and in-app wordmark with the Nightly ones and renames the app to Firefox Nightly.
